description.value: Functional images were preprocessed with slice scan time correction, high-pass temporal filtering, three-dimensional motion correction, coregistration, spatial normalization to Talairach space, and Gaussian spatial smoothing.

spans.text: The following preprocessing procedures were performed on the raw images: slice scan time correction (using cubic spline interpolation), high-pass temporal filtering to remove nonlinear drifts of three or fewer cycles per time course, three-dimensional motion correction to detect and correct for small head movements by spatial alignment of all volumes to the first volume by rigid body transformation, and spatial data smoothing using a Gaussian kernel with a 4 mm full width at half-maximum.
The BrainVoyager QX software package (Brain Innovations, Maastricht, The Netherlands) was used for all analyses.
